title: Answer: no theory of space, the world is what lies beyond the Markov blanket

statements.text: The theory offers no account of physical space. The spatial division it uses is the Markov blanket that separates system from not-system, so external states can only be inferred through the blanket. In the brain, opportunities in the world are registered in the superior colliculi and needs in the periaqueductal gray.

sources.quote: external states can only be "inferred" by the system—on the basis of "sensory impressions" upon the Markov blanket
